canonical_statement: If a topological space is covered by two open path-connected subspaces U and V, their intersection is path-connected, and a basepoint belongs to both, then the inclusion-induced square of based fundamental groups is a pushout in groups.
domain_and_universes: universe u; X : Type u; TopologicalSpace X; U V : Set X; x0 : X; the universal-property test group G : Type u
conclusion: The inclusion-induced homomorphisms from pi1(U intersection V, x0) to pi1(U, x0) and pi1(V, x0), followed by the ambient inclusions into pi1(X, x0), commute; every compatible pair into a group G factors uniquely through pi1(X, x0).

encoding.cover_members: sets U V with open predicates and U union V = univ
encoding.based_groups: Mathlib FundamentalGroup on subtypes U, V, and U intersection V
encoding.arrows: FundamentalGroup.map applied to continuous subtype inclusions
encoding.pushout: literal commutativity plus existence and uniqueness of the mediating group homomorphism

killed: weakened the pushout conclusion to generation by the two images
substituted an arbitrary assumed commutative group square

degenerate_cases: The common basepoint kernel-checks nonemptiness of U intersection V. The statement permits U = X, V = X, and U = V; it adds no properness or nontrivial-fundamental-group assumptions.
alternate_encodings: The free-product modulo normal closure presentation and the fundamental-groupoid theorem are not substituted for this target; either requires a separately checked transport.
status_boundary: Statement-only evidence: exact target, maps, universal property, mutations, and a nonempty-intersection boundary elaborate. No Seifert-van Kampen proof, source H0, anchor audit, or downstream completion is claimed.
